name: Ravenholdt Manor
summary: Ravenholdt Manor watches over Hillsbrad from high in the mountains. Lord Jorach Ravenholdt leads its guild of thieves and assassins, where practitioners of stealth hone their craft beyond the authorities’ reach.

sections.title: A Sanctuary in the Shadows
sections.body: Northwest of Durnholde Keep, a narrow pass and winding cave lead to Ravenholdt Manor. The estate stands isolated on the borderlands of the Alterac Mountains, and belongs to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt. He keeps a disciplined enclave of rogues, assassins, and intelligence operatives. A tranquil garden and outdoor training arena give them space to practice lockpicking, poison-crafting, and close-quarters combat under martial experts like Master Kang. Those with a talent for skullduggery are welcome, but watchful sentries greet clumsy outsiders and unwanted visitors with cold suspicion.

sections.title: A Bitter Feud in the Foothills
sections.body: Before the First War, the land around Ravenholdt Manor belonged to the kingdom of Alterac, a past recalled by the manor’s weathered orange roof tiles. After Alterac fell, its displaced nobles in the Syndicate sought control of the region, bringing them into conflict with Ravenholdt. Jorach’s followers fight across Hillsbrad and Alterac to preserve their sovereign haven.

faq.q: How do you reach Ravenholdt Manor?
faq.answer: Travel to the plateau northwest of Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad Foothills. Near the northern mountains, an obscure dirt path climbs through a hidden cave and emerges on the manor’s grounds.
Lord Jorach Ravenholdt owns the estate and leads the brotherhood of thieves and assassins known as Ravenholdt. Rogues throughout Azeroth hold him in deep respect.

faq.q: Why does Ravenholdt hate the Syndicate?
faq.answer: Both factions trace their roots to the shattered lands of Alterac. The Syndicate’s displaced nobles turn to banditry and lawlessness, while Ravenholdt works with strict discipline to thwart their ambitions.

Travelers can walk onto the grounds, where guards and assassins speak openly with hostility to outsiders. Rogues and trusted operatives receive a warm welcome and extensive training; others are warned to leave.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can find rigorous trials, specialized training, and a deep network of underground contacts at Ravenholdt Manor, the foremost sanctuary for your profession.
As an engineer, you can travel through the mountain pass to seek the rare schematic for the Gnomish Cloaking Device among the manor’s supplies.
